title: Manhattan Family Adventure: Marvel, Knicks & Mythology
summary: A two-day trip in Manhattan for a father and his 12-year-old son who love Marvel movies, Spider-Man, the New York Knicks, science, and Percy Jackson. The itinerary blends iconic landmarks, interactive museums, and family-friendly parks with halal meals and convenient prayer stops.

stops.why: Nine-floor Times Square wax museum featuring life-size celebrity and historic-figure replicas, interactive exhibits,…
stops.name: Madame Tussauds New York
stops.description: Nine-floor Times Square wax museum featuring life-size celebrity and historic-figure replicas, interactive exhibits, and a MARVEL 4D cinematic experience.

stops.why: Madison Square Garden is the home arena of the New York Knicks, offering a direct link to the team they love.
stops.name: Madison Square Garden
stops.description: Historic Manhattan arena hosting professional sports, concerts, and large-scale events, offering premium hospitality, concessions, and guided tours.

stops.why: Masjid Awliya of Allah is a 24-hour prayer space near Midtown, convenient for Dhuhr prayer.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Kwik Meal NYC is a verified halal street vendor serving lamb over rice and other quick bites, ideal for a family lunch.
stops.name: Kwik Meal NYC
stops.description: Unpretentious halal street vendor serving lamb over rice, sandwiches, curry and rice platters for inexpensive late-night quick bites.

stops.why: Masjid Awliya of Allah is available for Asr prayer in the same convenient location.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES is an interactive spy-themed museum with games and challenges, great for a child who enjoys science and interactive experiences.
stops.name: SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES
stops.description: Interactive spy-themed museum and experience center offering immersive challenges, skill-testing missions, and a personalized 58-page spy profile.

stops.why: Masjid Awliya of Allah is nearby for Maghrib prayer after an afternoon of exploration.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Adel's Famous Halal Food is a popular halal cart serving chicken and lamb gyros, rice plates, and falafel, verified halal and good for kids.
stops.name: Adel's Famous Halal Food
stops.description: Popular Midtown halal food cart serving chicken and lamb gyros, rice plates, falafel, and signature white sauce; open late-night until 4–5 AM.

stops.why: Central Park is a sprawling urban park with lakes, trails, a zoo, and playgrounds, offering open space for a child to explore and play.
stops.name: Central Park
stops.description: Sprawling urban park offering lakes, gardens, trails, recreational facilities, a zoo, carousel, boat rentals, and iconic reservoir views.

stops.why: Central Park Zoo is a small, family-focused zoo in the park featuring penguins, sea lions, and a children's petting zoo, engaging a young explorer's interest in animals and nature.
stops.name: Central Park Zoo
stops.description: Small, family-focused zoo in Central Park showcasing penguins, sea lions, primates, and a children's petting zoo, emphasizing conservation and interactive exhibits.

stops.why: Masjid Awliya of Allah is within a reasonable distance for Dhuhr prayer from the Central Park area.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: The Halal Guys is a verified halal street-food chain famous for its chicken and gyro platters with white and hot sauces, ideal for a family lunch near the park.
stops.name: The Halal Guys
stops.description: Street-food origin chain serving signature halal chicken, gyro and rice platters topped with famous white and hot sauces near Union Square.

stops.why: Asr at the mosque nearest to The Halal Guys.
stops.name: Masjid Ar-Rahman
stops.description: Midtown Manhattan mosque serving the local Muslim community with daily prayers, religious services, and community outreach in a compact urban setting.

stops.why: Iconic art deco skyscraper with exhibits and observatories overlooking New York City.
stops.name: Empire State Building
stops.description: Iconic art deco skyscraper with exhibits and observatories overlooking New York City.

stops.why: Masjid Awliya of Allah is nearby for Maghrib prayer to conclude the day.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Burger World is a verified halal burger spot near Port Authority offering grass-fed beef burgers, chicken fingers, and garlic fries, good for kids and a satisfying dinner.
stops.name: Burger World
stops.description: Compact halal burger spot near Port Authority offering hand-shaped grass-fed beef burgers, chicken fingers, garlic fries, gyros, salads and quick takeout/delivery.

tips: Purchase tickets for Madame Tussauds and SPYSCAPE online in advance to skip lines.
Check Madison Square Garden's schedule for any public tours or events on your visit day.
Use Central Park's playgrounds and open spaces for breaks between sightseeing.
Carry a small prayer rug for convenience during prayer stops.
